toolchain: OpenVMX x86-64 from commit dc365b3286cbc607007ddc9bd482c0d6ef98b15c with MadGoat MMK in headless QEMU
semantic_scope: The offline OpenVMX guest read back the original description. MMK selected HELLO and ran its DCL recipe, which printed the exact line `Hello, World!`. MMK returned VMS condition 1 (SS$_NORMAL). The OpenVMX DCL launcher displayed an abort label and exposed its own failure value %X0000002C in $STATUS.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
